adjudication.note: the held-out hit rate and the cross-domain false-alarm rate carried the claim; the shuffle placebo is uninformative for a level-driven signal.

placebo_interpretation: shuffling preserves the residual level, so a 100% placebo rate shows the detector is level-driven, not order-driven. The meaningful null is the demand-driven (legit) group, where the same detector produced 0% false alarms.
